note: Forest Preserve District of Kane County campground in Burnidge Forest Preserve, one mile west of Randall Road on Big Timber Road near Elgin. Improved sites take vehicle or tent campers; five equestrian sites sit on a separate loop and ten walk-in primitive tent sites lie to the south. Horse trails and mowed hiking trails through the preserve. --Claude
summary: FPDKC page, campground map (2023), FAQs, 2025 rules, imagery read. Fees 26 resident / +15 nonresident confirmed (manual). Booking: online-only via ActivityReg (operator, url), reservations required (manual). Season 05-01 to third Sunday in October (closes 10-17 for 2027, manual). 50A + water, 104 sites, 50-ft rigs, dump (manual). Equestrian sites on a separate loop: horse rule passes. PIN MOVE ~260 m: stored is the north parking lot. Not waterfront kept.
flags: PIN MOVE (~260 m): stored 42.07135,-88.35984 is the north parking lot by the ponds and camp office; the improved-site loops centre on ~42.0690,-88.3600 (Esri imagery, matched to the district's inset map). Suggest 42.0690,-88.3600.
HORSES: passes. The 5 equestrian sites are a separate loop ('5 Equestrian Camp Sites' around Equestrian Shelter 2 on the map), apart from the 89 improved sites.
SEASON: 'May 1 through the third Sunday in October'; written closes 10-17 (2027's date) with the rule in season.note. The old stored season had no close.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront KEPT. Two fishing ponds and Tyler Creek lie north and east of the loops, 150+ m from the nearest improved site, past the parking lot and woods.
FACILITIES: map shows a flush restroom and vault restrooms; no showers on any district page (not written).
PHONE 630-444-1200 (campground reservations hotline) and WEBSITE https://kaneforest.com/location/paul-wolff current, kept.
